reasons.point-the-tip-red: Gives a face-up arrow that Azalea put into arsenal +3 power and an aim counter, which turns on Drill, Infecting and Murkmire bonuses and pushes power above base for Bolt'n Shot and Bolt'n Boots.
reasons.blessing-of-focus-red: Opt 3 at the start of your turn, then puts a revealed arrow face-up into arsenal with an aim counter, which sets up Azalea and every aim-matters arrow.
reasons.silver-the-tip-red: Digs 4 cards deep and puts an arrow face-up into arsenal from your deck, which triggers Crow's Nest and Dry Powder Shot.
reasons.fletch-a-red-tail-red: The biggest arrow pump in the pool at +4 with go again, and aimed arrows also get Red cards -1 defense while defending them.
reasons.over-flex-red: +4 arrow pump with reload keeps the arsenal refilled and the Azalea arrow chain going.
reasons.sinker-blue: A much-needed blue pitch card that puts a top-deck arrow face-up into arsenal (Crow's Nest and Dry Powder triggers) with overpower.
reasons.line-blue: Blue pitch that puts a top-deck arrow face-up into arsenal with go again, so the turn keeps chaining.
reasons.hook-blue: Blue pitch that puts a top-deck arrow face-up into arsenal with +1 power, which also turns on Bolt'n Shot's above-base clause.
reasons.sedation-shot-red: Gets +1 power with an aim counter and creates an Inertia token on hit, matching the deck's debuff-token plan.
reasons.withering-shot-red: Gets +1 power with an aim counter and creates a Frailty token on hit, adding to the token pressure.
